verdicts.reason: A rearranges for the tall format, but the 'CORE BUILDING' headline has shrunk to a tiny 'CoreBuilding' caption. The logo is blown up huge and collides with a thin green strip that is all that remains of the brand band, and large dead white gaps separate the headline, photo and logo. B is just the original shrunk into a small letterbox in the middle with about 60% empty white above and below, so its tagline is illegibly small and nothing has been rearranged for the format.
